messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate alert for /v1/generate — 5xx spike + gateway timeouts. Alert: https://grafana.redwood.local/alert/ALERT-789 - error_rate=14% over 1m. Paging on-call @maria.

aj: seeing same. Lots of 429s coming from quota-service which then surface as 502/504 at the gateway. quick grep: 'quota_service.*429' is flooding logs.

maria: oncall responding. I'm pulling logs and looking for recent deploys or config changes in the last 10m. anyone who touched rate limiting?

leo: I rolled out a tighter default tenant cap ~7m ago — PR #4567. It changed keying semantics for default buckets. rolling back now.

deploy-bot: Reverting release rl-config-2026-02 (deploy id dpl-9987) to previous config.

maria: logs show clear pattern: quota-service returning 429 and gateway proxing as 502. sample: 
```
2026-03-15T09:12:07Z quota-service ERROR tenant=acct_42 code=429 reason=quota_exceeded limit=1000 window=60
2026-03-15T09:12:08Z gateway WARN upstream=quota-service status=502 path=/v1/generate req_id=abc123
```

aj: i can reproduce with a quick stress loop locally: 
```
for i in {1..500}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate; done
```
quota-service token bucket drains fast due to sliding-window calc bug after the config change.

maria: temporary mitigation — switching quota enforcement to soft-fail so requests can pass through while we fix the service. executing controlplane override now.
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/quotas/override -d '{"mode":"soft-fail","targets":["quota-service"]}'
```
deploy-bot: Override applied by maria at 09:13 UTC.

sophie: support checking customer impact. Top affected: acct_42 and acct_99 — dashboards show increased errors and timeouts. i'll notify account teams and send a status update.

leo: restarting quota-service pods to clear the token-bucket state: 
`kubectl rollout restart deployment/quota-service -n prod`
deploy-bot: quota-service rollout started (rs: rs-773) by leo.

maria: after override + restart, 5xx dropped from ~14% -> ~1.8% over the next 2m. Grafana shows recovery trend: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/alerts/recent?panelId=5

aj: root cause hypothesis: a bad merge in rl-config changed the default keying so multiple tenants shared a bucket (wildcard key). patch ready: PR #4571 fixes key calculation and adds e2e for tenant isolation.

maria: handing incident to @leo for infra follow-up and @aj for the service patch. on-call handoff: leo will own stability until quota-service is green. aj owns the PR and canary rollout.

leo: adding temporary whitelist for high-SLA tenants (acct_42, acct_99) and will monitor. Also increasing token bucket size for a short window.

sophie: sent emails to affected customers and posted an incident note on status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2799004321 — included ETA for full remediation.

maria: marking paging/responsiveness resolved from SRE side. Next steps: postmortem, CI validation for rate-limit config, add a rollback runbook specific to quota changes, and a throttle-surge playbook.

aj: PR created and tests added: https://git.redwood.ai/pr/4571 - assigning to maria for postmortem signoff.

maria: thanks everyone. adding action items to the incident board and closing this thread. :thumbsup:
